question.text: Mr. Arjun Kapoor is an employee of the manager of a Cat II AIF scheme. What is the MINIMUM amount he must invest in that scheme under SEBI's employee/director concession?

explanation.text: The Logic: SEBI (AIF) Regulations carve out a concessional minimum investment of INR 25 lakh for employees and directors of the manager of an AIF scheme, versus the INR 1 crore floor that applies to ordinary non-employee, non-accredited investors. Accredited Investors are governed separately under the AI framework, which gives flexibility on the minimum amount and does NOT equate to a fixed INR 25 lakh floor. The Trap: INR 50 lakh is a fabricated mid-point. INR 1 crore is the ordinary LP floor for non-employee, non-accredited investors. INR 2 crore is fabricated. Note: The INR 25 lakh concession is reserved for employees and directors of the AIF manager; Accredited Investors enjoy flexibility on minimums under a separate framework and should not be conflated with this employee carve-out.
